extra:
Additional upstream documentation is installed in /usr/share/doc/org.kernel.pahole.
.SH SEE ALSO
.BR pahole (1),
.BR pfunct (1)

codiff.description: compare type and function information in object files

ctracer.description: generate tracing support from debugging information

pglobal.description: display global symbols and their debugging information

syscse.description: inspect debugging information for system call structures

btfdiff.description: compare DWARF and BTF type layouts
btfdiff.synopsis:
btfdiff DWARF_FILE [BTF_FILE]
PAHOLE selects the pahole executable.

fullcircle.description: compare original and regenerated type information
fullcircle.synopsis:
fullcircle FILE
PFUNCT and CODIFF select the helper executables.
The helper compiles regenerated C with gcc.
